title: Actor movement for verified Roxas and rescue Mickey
status: Implemented; Root central native tests passed; independently reviewed; live gameplay untested.
scope: Only ActorMovementFeatures.inl and its existing native test source changed. No EffectCatalog, bridge, version, coverage, live process or IDB mutation.

implementation.legacyReady: actor_movement::Ready body unchanged: Sora-only dependency contract used by CollisionFeatures and TargetingFeatures.
implementation.newReady: actor_movement::MovementReady is called only by ActorMovementHandle/Snapshot. It reuses damage/scene/thread/pool/lifetime guards and actual player_role::Inspect, then pins the selected movement vtable slot and all8 wrapper bytes.
implementation.write: One writable float32 field per successful command, no native function call or retained Actor/restore pointer.
implementation.snapshot: Same identity gates, paused-field observation allowed, individual nonfinite values omitted.
implementation.restore: Completed runtime values remain until native script/reconstruction overwrites them. No automatic restore or reapplication. Explicit profile application is one-time.

nativeSupport.extra: Actor form must also match saved current Sora Form byte9ACDD4.
Actor/object/status must agree. Do not substitute Sora's saved current Form byte for Roxas identity.
Exact rescue class only. Attached/inactive/deleting/departure/transition states rejected.

crowdControl.status: Not approved for cross-role timed effects in this change.
crowdControl.reason: Current managed OwnedValue state is not bound to a concrete Actor lifetime. A same-valued role replacement may retain an old Actor's restore value. Role admission alone does not fix this. EffectCatalog remains owned by the other agent.
crowdControl.text: Moon Jump changes base jump height and maximum falling speed; it does not modify native gravity. High Jump and special actions can override base height.

tests.execution: Root executed the native suites; this agent read and copied the resulting logs without another build.
tests.added: Actual role helper fixtures for Roxas forms0/10 and rescue Mickey11; all4 fields with endpoints/fraction, exact4-byte Actor delta, status/save preservation, paused snapshots/write refusal, wrong descriptor/object/form, both wrapper byte corruption, current Actor replacement, full list/pool lifetime, read-only memory, host/thread/transition gates, and retained negative legacy Ready for Collision/Targeting.

evidenceSummary.validation: verify.py compares each complete saved body and static vtable/descriptor against the SHA-pinned original EXE; no game process or native call.

limitations: No live gameplay test. Static layout/use and isolated fixture intentions are separate from real gameplay behavior.
No universal movement multiplier: special Actions can choose other movement paths; High Jump can replace base jump height.
Ranges are trainer edit policy. Loaded character-group defaults can differ from base initializer2/8/160; preset20 is not a measured per-character fall default.
Gameplay/input gates are the module's existing gates, not a new atomic application-wide control policy.
No compatibility is asserted for arbitrary mod-rewritten code or concurrent external writes.
The extension does not broaden Collision, Targeting, Motion, Drive, or any timed Twitch effect.
